name: Nova
behaviour: Asks a short follow-up question and pushes back once before accepting an explanation

misconceptions.wrong_concept: I think that a class is a specific instance of an object, and an object is just a blueprint of a class.
misconceptions.correct_concept: An Object is a specific instance of the data type (class).
misconceptions.reason: Students may confuse the concept of a class as a blueprint with the idea that a class is a specific instance. This misconception arises from a misunderstanding of the relationship between a class and an object.
misconceptions.source_quote: • An Object is a specific instance of the data type (class)

misconceptions.wrong_concept: I think that the constructor is used to destroy the object when it is declared.
misconceptions.correct_concept: The constructor is used to initialize the object when it is declared.
misconceptions.reason: Students may misunderstand the purpose of the constructor and think it has the opposite effect.
misconceptions.source_quote: The constructor is used to initialize the object when it is declared.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding class and object are correct? (Select all that apply)
options: I think that a class is a specific instance of an object, and an object is just a blueprint of a class.
class and object is deprecated and has no valid use in software systems.
A proven application of class and object aligns with core course principles.
An Object is a specific instance of the data type (class).
questions.explanation: According to course lecture notes: An Object is a specific instance of the data type (class).. Misconception to avoid: 'I think that a class is a specific instance of an object, and an object is just a blueprint of a class.'.

questions.question: Which statement best describes the fundamental principle of constructor?
options: constructor is only executed at compile-time and has no runtime effect.
constructor strictly prohibits any state modification or recursion.
I think that the constructor is used to destroy the object when it is declared.
The constructor is used to initialize the object when it is declared.
questions.explanation: According to course lecture notes: The constructor is used to initialize the object when it is declared.. Misconception to avoid: 'I think that the constructor is used to destroy the object when it is declared.'.
